in_marathi.name: Kalavati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of abundance and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalavati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kalavati is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Kalavati means 'Goddess of the universe'. She is often depicted as sitting on a lotus flower and holding a lotus in each of her four hands, symbolizing the abundance and prosperity she brings to the world.
